Dear [Mr Woollcombe](/person/1560)
I am just come home from Devon. I will send your letter to [Macmillan](/person/942), I think he will consider that admission to a school will make it quite worth while to cheapen it. I will ask one of the partners to write direct to you. I hope your brother [Robert](/person/1559)has improved since I left Torquay, on Saturday, but the weather, keeping him indoors, is much against him

yours sincerely

C M Yonge
